title: Rack Pull
summary: A deadlift from pins at about knee height that trains heavy lockouts for the back, traps and glutes.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: barbell (Olympic bar); weight plates; rack with J-hooks (power rack, squat stands or bench uprights).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for traps (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly traps total.
Library rating 0.8 for lower back (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly lower back total.
Library rating 0.7 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.7 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.6 for upper back (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly upper back total.
Library rating 0.6 for forearms (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly forearms total.

Library rating 0.3 for lats (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly lats total.

setup.text: Set the bar on pins just below or at your knees and grip it just outside your legs.
Brace, then drive your hips forward to stand tall.
Lower back to the pins under control.

form_cues.cue: Brace and pull the slack out
Drive the hips forward to lockout
Don't lean back at the top. Stand tall and stop.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where you can fail a rep safely, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less upper-trap work.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less upper-trap work, Less grip demand.
Swap sheet: More stretch emphasis, Less upper-trap work, More stable.
